top_signals.title: China’s Refiners Turn to Africa and Brazil Crude as Freight Rates Ease
top_signals.summary: China’s refiners are buying crude oil from West Africa and Brazil after freight rates eased in the past two weeks, while competition for Russian supply is stronger and Iranian barrels have disappeared. Following a decline in shipping rates from all-time highs, some Chinese refiners have bought West African and Brazilian crude grades at premiums of up to $20 per barrel above ICE Brent for delivery in December, trading sources told Bloomberg on Wednesday. In early October, the freight rates of crude cargoes from the Atlantic Basin to Asia soared…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sandoz Warns EU May Scrap Antibiotic Protection, Harm Plant
top_signals.summary: Sandoz Group AG said Europe’s medicines regulator is proposing to pull amoxicillin from its list of critical medicines, a potential death blow to the last European factory to make the antibiotic from scratch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: S&P 500 Churns in Countdown to Fed, Tech Earnings: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street investors refrained from making big moves before key tech results and a Federal Reserve decision that will shape the outlook for markets through the remainder of 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Robinhood's third-quarter revenue met expectations, fueled by the company's expansion into options, predictions markets and other financial services.
